marketing_wrapper: Each frame: a backdrop that echoes an event theme (purple-blue grid glow in 01/06, navy starfield in 02/04, peach gradient in 03, blurred photo in 05), a bold title-case caption with grey subline in the top ~22%, and a black-bezel iPhone cropped at the bottom (~65%). Marketing pop-outs overlap the frame: the iridescent 'Going' orb (01), category chips (02), a pixel-art 'partiful' speech bubble (03), and 'Ben is Going 👍' / emoji count stickers (05, 06). 04 is mostly the system Messages app showing a Partiful text blast, not Partiful UI. Real app UI: event page (01), image picker sheet (02), share sheet (03), Explore (05), photo album + activity feed (06).

typography.display: Custom-looking wide grotesque in bold for in-app titles and the wordmark (lexi's 26th, Trending in LA, Date my friend, Photo Album); lowercase event titles; name unsure. User poster art brings its own type (serif, 3D chrome, condensed slab)
typography.body: custom grotesque or SF — unsure; secondary text (dates, 'Grace +32 are Interested') in a regular grey
typography.numerals: proportional; dates and times written out in body text (Wed, January 22, 9:30pm – 11:30pm); emoji reaction counts in pills
typography.weights: Bold display, semibold card titles, regular body; strong weight contrast
typography.case_and_tracking: Event titles often lowercase (lexi's 26th, explore los angeles in a torn-paper label); tight display tracking; times lowercase am/pm

palette.accent_strategy: Per-content and brand-flooded at once: each event page takes its theme from the user's poster (iridescent lavender for one event, deep indigo-violet grid glow for another), so the page colour is user-authored. Chrome stays neutral (white sheets, dark Explore cards) and emoji provide most small-scale colour.
palette.source: palette.json 01: #dbe0f1 / #b5d2f1 = iridescent event-page theme, #8302c7 / #18045e / #522b80 = purple-blue marketing glow; 06: #07052e / #350365 / #2a005c = dark violet event theme; 05: #21201f = Explore dark cards; 03: #fbf9fb / #f9e8e1 = share sheet and peach backdrop. #1a7cf5 is the iMessage View button (system).

shape.radius_language: pill and large: pill category chips, reaction chips and buttons (Upload, View all), ~16pt cards and sheets, circular icon buttons and avatars, ~4pt on poster images
shape.borders_shadows: 1px light outlines on pills over dark themes; iridescent gradient edge around the shared poster card; soft drop shadow on stickers (marketing)
shape.materials: Mixed: frosted/iridescent sheet surfaces over themed backgrounds, torn-paper and sticker collage graphics in Explore, animated-looking glow grid themes

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: the 'Going' RSVP orb in 01 is a glossy iridescent bubble and the image-picker search field is frosted, but it reads as Partiful's own effect rather than system glass
density: medium: event page is a title, square poster, date/time and host block; Explore cards are thumbnail + title + time + blurb + attendee facepile
layout: Event page: small wordmark, centred lowercase event title, a square user poster, then date/time, host and RSVP. Explore: torn-paper city hero, 'Trending in LA' heading, then dark rounded cards with a poster thumbnail, emoji category tag, title, time and facepile. Album: horizontal photo strip then an activity feed with emoji reaction pills.
navigation: No tab bar visible in any frame. Bottom sheets with grab handles for image search and Share Link; share targets as a circular icon row (Copy Link, Messages, WhatsApp, More); top-right outline pill buttons.
imagery_and_icons: User/house poster art (collage, 3D chrome type, photography), users' party photos, heavy emoji as category icons and reactions (💃 🎂 🧘 👋 🎨 🔥 📣 👍), a pixel-art speech bubble, sticker/torn-paper graphics; few line icons.
signature_visual_move: The event page wears the user's poster: the whole page background shifts to match the chosen theme (iridescent lavender, violet grid glow) while the RSVP sits as a glossy emoji orb.
tells_present: Emoji as icons (category chips, reactions, RSVP button)
Purple, indigo, violet; purple-to-blue gradient (event themes and marketing)

direction_fit.why: The poster and theme set the page; chrome is a thin neutral layer. The tells appear as deliberate, user-chosen expression rather than default output, which fits the direction's 'permission to be tacky'.

notes: Tells here are on-brand, not template residue; the dealer should treat emoji-as-icon and purple glow as allowed only on the user's artifact, per the direction's restraint rule. 04 is system Messages, so it shouldn't be used for chrome judgements.
